note: Ranked on impact_sum: the hunters' signed per-finding sizes, added up, in points of spot. No call and no threshold -- cut wherever you like afterwards, which is what keeps the ranking question answerable at every k. `conviction` (abs of the key) is where the direction skill lives: over all events the sign is a coin flip, above the median conviction it is 74%. conviction_floor is a floor on emphasis in the note, never a filter on this file. Everything under `diagnostics` was measured as neutral or subtractive and decides nothing -- see researcher_us/EDGE_ANALYSIS.md.

hunter_view.bar: quarterly_report_only filer, and the dated event is an Annual Report rather than a 4E, so there is no EPS bar. I sized against cash and runway as last stated by the company: A$54.6m cash at 30 Jun 2026, plus a single-tranche A$52.5m placement at A$0.55 giving about A$95m pro-forma cash. MRE update targeted for early Q4 CY2026 (drill cut-off end Sep 2026), DFS late CY2026. Sources: https://announcements.asx.com.au/asxpdf/20260923/pdf/074drz7bbmyd84.pdf (company announcement, 23 Sep 2026) and https://www.proactiveinvestors.com/companies/news/1098925/aurum-resources-raises-a-52-5-million-to-accelerate-boundiali-gold-project-in-cote-d-ivoire-1098925.html. The audited 30 June balance sheet cannot differ materially from the 5B already lodged 28 Jul 2026, so the expected surprise against this bar is about zero.
hunter_view.positioning_check: ASIC aggregate short 0.901% (3.75m shares) as of 2026-09-23, lag 4 sessions, up from 0.716% on 2026-09-16. The build falls exactly on the placement date (halt 21 Sep, placement announced 23 Sep at A$0.55). The likeliest reading is placees hedging their allocations: those shorts are covered by delivery of the new shares on the 29 Sep settlement, not by buying in the market. So it is neither squeeze fuel nor an informed bearish view. At under 1% of the register it is small either way. The priced lean of +0.70 comes mostly from the -10.6% 20-day and -9.0% 5-day run-up. The 5-day fall is placement pricing plus the gold slide.
hunter_view.baseline_tension: No tension to resolve. I found nothing that agrees with or cuts against the +0.70 lean. The oversold 5-day and 20-day run-up is explained by the placement and by gold, and neither gives a reason to expect a reversal or a continuation on 1 Oct specifically.

hunter_view.positioning_check: ASIC aggregate short 1.2836% (8.24m shares) as of 2026-09-23, up from 0.7697% on 09-16, so +0.51pp building, with a 4-session lag. USL was halted from 22 Sept 09:29 until 24 Sept, so the whole build was put on over 16 to 21 Sept, ahead of a placement priced at a 10.1% discount. That was either pre-deal hedging or shorting into the 18 Sept +13% spike on 15.8m shares. Either way those shorts are about 16% in profit at 0.705, and any that are placement hedges will be closed by delivering the 1 Oct allotment, not by buying on market. At 1.28% it is not a crowded short and gives no squeeze fuel. The lean's squeeze and run-up terms (+0.77, +1.02) read the post-raise drop as mean-reversion fuel, but about half of the -16.6% 5-day move is the 10.1% placement discount and the rest tracks silver (SI=F 65.93 on 09-22 to 61.31 on 09-29, -7.0%).
hunter_view.baseline_tension: Nothing I found gives a direction. The lean (+0.76) reads the -16.6% five-day drop and the short build as rebound fuel, but the drop is explained by a public 10.1%-discount placement plus a 7% fall in silver, and the build most likely closes by delivery on 1 Oct, not on market. I neither agree nor disagree with the lean and I add nothing to it.
